# Test fixture sources

- `pq_gradient.jxl`: from the libjxl test data
  (https://github.com/libjxl/testdata, `jxl/pq_gradient.jxl`), BSD 3-Clause
  license, copyright the JPEG XL Project Authors.
- `sdr8.jxl`: a 4x2 lossless 8-bit sRGB image made with libjxl for these tests.
- The `.jxr` files are generated by `make_hdr64.py` and `make_inputs.py`.
